title: SCE Schedule TOU-GS-2, Option D — General Service, Time-of-Use with Time-Related Demand, 20-200 kW (DRAFT, UNVERIFIED)
notes:
PENDING. Option D carries BOTH facilities-related demand (FRD) and time-related demand (TRD) charges, unlike Option E (../option-e/), which has FRD only. This is a v1 target per product decision, alongside Option E. CPP variants (D-CPP, B-CPP) are excluded from v1 — they need a critical-peak event calendar this repo does not have. Options B and R are closed to new enrollment; grandfathered customers still exist, so a record is added only if a real bill turns out to need one, not speculatively.

Secondary-source structural facts (SCE's public rate summary/factsheets — NOT the tariff sheet, do not treat as verified, but used to shape which fields below are worth filling first): summer on-peak is 4:00-9:00 p.m. on summer weekdays, excluding holidays. FRD applies year-round, all hours, all days. TRD applies to summer On-Peak and winter Mid-Peak, WEEKDAYS ONLY, excluding weekends and holidays — note the winter TRD period is Mid-Peak, not On-Peak. That means once rates are known, demandCharges.timeRelated should end up with exactly two entries (summer/on-peak, winter/mid-peak), not one per season.
